ansible-check-mode.purpose: Understand what Ansible check and diff modes can establish.
ansible-check-mode.inputs: Playbook tasks, module versions and expected side effects.
ansible-check-mode.approach: Compare each module's dry-run support and explicit task overrides.
ansible-check-mode.outputs: A realistic validation plan and known blind spots.
ansible-check-mode.requirements: Official version-matched docs and the relevant playbook.
ansible-check-mode.limits: Dry runs cannot establish every execution path; diff output may contain sensitive content.
ansible-check-mode.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.

ansible-galaxy.purpose: Find maintained Ansible collections for an automation need.
ansible-galaxy.inputs: Required capability, Ansible version and publisher requirements.
ansible-galaxy.approach: Compare collection documentation, maintenance and version compatibility.
ansible-galaxy.outputs: Candidate collection and version to evaluate.
ansible-galaxy.requirements: Catalog access to browse; Ansible environment to install or execute a collection.
ansible-galaxy.limits: Collections are automation packages, not agent skills; selecting one does not install it.
ansible-galaxy.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.

ansible-guide.purpose: Plan, inspect or troubleshoot a bounded Ansible change.
ansible-guide.inputs: Desired state, inventory, playbook, versions and target scope.
ansible-guide.approach: Resolve hosts, inspect side effects, validate locally and use a bounded test before rollout.
ansible-guide.outputs: Reviewable change, observed checks and recovery plan.
ansible-guide.requirements: Existing Ansible controller, collections and authorized target access for execution.
ansible-guide.limits: Check mode is module-dependent; diff can reveal secrets and some tasks opt out of dry-run behavior.
ansible-guide.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.

course-building-guide.purpose: Connect course planning documents and evidence-based revisions.
course-building-guide.inputs: Learners, syllabus/objectives, modules, assessments and existing evaluation evidence.
course-building-guide.approach: Link or create missing artifacts, map objective-to-assessment alignment and inspect the actual LMS before editing.
course-building-guide.outputs: Connected course workspace and traceable improvement proposals.
course-building-guide.requirements: Document tools; authorized LMS/browser access only when portal work is needed.
course-building-guide.limits: Platform references do not prove local configuration; planned outcomes and observed results must stay distinct.
course-building-guide.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.

project-learning-ledger.purpose: Keep useful project memory and optional analysis-ready records.
project-learning-ledger.inputs: Current decisions, observations, lessons and an agreed storage location.
project-learning-ledger.approach: Capture concise typed records, retrieve relevant lessons and preserve comparable analysis slices.
project-learning-ledger.outputs: Portable memory notes/JSON ledger and optional validated analysis export.
project-learning-ledger.requirements: Local files; Python for the included validator/exporter.
project-learning-ledger.limits: No memory service is included; never manufacture numeric evidence from prose or combine incomparable populations.
project-learning-ledger.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.

request-guide.purpose: Coordinate several requests toward one outcome.
request-guide.inputs: Outcome, request IDs/links, owners and dated status evidence.
request-guide.approach: Track dependencies and distinguish administrative closure from observed completion.
request-guide.outputs: Small request tracker, blocker summary and follow-up drafts.
request-guide.requirements: Supplied snapshots or an authorized source connection.
request-guide.limits: Stale observations stay dated; sending and scheduled checks are separate capabilities and actions.
request-guide.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.
